answer: Let attestations define a weighted graph, with trust assigned by bounded-length random walks from independently anchored sources. A Sybil cluster that is an island linked to the honest graph by a sparse cut has low conductance, so few walks enter it. Its walk-derived voting mass is bounded by cut capacity relative to cluster volume, not by its internal thread of fabricated links. This min-cut bound limits aggregate influence, while genuine cross-links from an orchard of honest agents can raise conductance.
